concerns.text: The null distribution is generated by **block‑permutations** of size b = 100 that preserve intra‑block order. Because autocorrelation depends on the relative ordering of adjacent values, preserving block structure leaves residual dependence that is not independent of the observed autocorrelation. Consequently, the p‑values derived from this null model are not truly independent of the predictor (the observed sequence), creating a circular/tautological validation of the random‑sign hypothesis.
